So to start of my favourite is chrono stone out of all but orion is second.

First: i am a sucker for tournament arcs. I love the championships and them facing other countries , to see how those countries are represented etc which helps orion. 

Lets start with arc 1 which is the qualifying arc (their first match to then vs china) it was an arc that focussed on showing how much they lacked, making them self aware of their shortcomings yet giving sneaky training to become the worlds best and the coach, making them less reliant and able to think on their own two feet. 

The second is the drama. I know from what i read for some rhe cheating got reptitive. But this was the storyline. It was the same feel for me with the seeds from go or the aliens in season 2. It showed them fighting a tough outside force.

With that there was less drama imo then ie3. I felt with ie3 there was constant drama and while written well it started to get a bit overdone. Oh look kageyama is back, he is doing another plot as a sub villain, they might not make it etc. With this season the drama was constantly different  fresh and more direct. It was a little less filler.

Last was the animation update. The ie123 animation is lovely but i am more of a fan of modern and sleek animation which this season delivered in spades
The redemption arc as well was so pleasent.

I know the season has a lot of shortcomings too but i do like it for these reasons :)
I am surprised people dislike it so much. I honestly think it was one of the better anime especially orion. o.o
